description: This PHP file contains utility functions for the SugarCRM platform, specifically for generating JavaScript validation scripts and HTML forms related to the Settings module, such as forms for creating new records and validating user input.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of form data, including email validation and required fields.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Creates an HTML form for entering a new record, dynamically generating form fields based on database schema and including validation data.
